{{Top|leg}}
A '''glowsphere''' was an illumination device. [[Greezim Trentacal]] used glowspheres aboard his [[Zuraco Cargo Hauler]] ''[[Atron's Mistress]]''. They were used to great effect by the [[Red Moons]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to defeat Trentacal's [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Vex (Defel)|Vex]] when they turned them up to full brightness and blinded him.
